menu:11026260:1.text: Hm? A visitor who can see me?
menu:11026260:1.source_cn: 嗯？一位能看见我的访客？

say:1:1631134001:1.text: A conversation across life and death is no easy thing... If you can see me, you must have mastered the essence of transformation magic and touched the wisdom of the ancestors.

say:3:1631134002:0.text: That child Loraine... So she really did it, becoming a professor at the Serene Lyceum. That's wonderful.
say:3:1631134002:0.source_cn: 罗兰那孩子……她果然做到了，成为了莱希拉姆的教师……真好。

say:0:1631134501:0.text: Rich, deep aroma... The oak-aged vintage must be here.

say:0:1631134601:0.text: Professor Stuart said she might be near the teaching building.
say:0:1631134601:0.source_cn: 把酒带给罗兰吧……斯图尔特老师说过，她可能会在教学楼左...

say:2:1631135002:1.text: Professor Stuart... is this... really true?
say:2:1631135002:1.source_cn: 斯图尔特老师……这是……真的吗？
say:2:1631135002:1.male: Professor Stuart... is this... really true?
say:2:1631135002:1.female: Professor Stuart... is this... really true?

say:3:1631135004:1.source_cn: 果然……老师他一直都记得这个约定。

say:4:1631135005:1.text: This gift is his final recognition of me.
say:4:1631135005:1.source_cn: ……这份礼物，便是他给予我的最终认可。

say:5:1631135006:1.text: Thank you very much. I will treasure this and strive to become a mentor as worthy of respect as my professor once was.
say:5:1631135006:1.source_cn: 非常感谢你。我必将这份认可铭记于心，努力成为像老师那样...
